methodology.year_level_qc: N >= 10 is eligible for primary comparison
methodology.multi_year_metrics: Calculated from pooled raw observation/product pairs when extraction.csv is available.
methodology.product_ranking: Equal-weight mean rank of median RMSE, median MAE, median absolute bias, median correlation and median R2 across qualifying Site × Product pooled records.
methodology.coverage_rule: Products retain their actual available years; missing product years are not imputed.

limitations: The GEE layer uses the available BharatFlux site-years from 2014–2018.
SSEBop contributes its available 2014–2018 year-level benchmark.
Products retain asymmetric coverage where BharatFlux site-years or product observations are unavailable.
